other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in target encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is applied directly to the training set without out-of-fold (K-fold) predictions or noise injection. This causes the target variable to leak directly into the training features, leading to severe overfitting.

other_failure_modes.name: Flawed out-of-sample ranking
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes rank features on continuous variables by creating an exact dictionary mapping from the training set. Any unseen continuous values in the validation/test sets will fail the dictionary lookup and be assigned a default value (0.5), destroying the rank ordering for new data.

summary: The agent implements a sophisticated Mixture of Experts deep learning architecture with comprehensive data splitting, multi-seed ensembling, and substantial feature engineering. However, the solution suffers from a critical data leakage flaw due to naive target encoding on the training set without cross-validation. Additionally, the approach to computing rank features for out-of-sample data is logically flawed and will break on continuous unseen values.
